color.note: Light is the default for marketing, docs and decks. Dark is the default for the product command centre. Green carries the brand on light; aqua carries it on navy. Every semantic token has both values.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text on it: `text` (14:1 or better), `text-muted` (5.1:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows and inputs sitting on `bg`. Text: `text`, `text-muted`, `action`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills, hover rows, segmented controls. Text: `text`, `text-muted` (4.6:1 light).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark feature panels on a light page (hero card, dark deck slides). Text on it: `text-inverse`, `aqua`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; use `border-strong` for anything that carries meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input outlines, checkbox edges and any border that identifies a control (3:1 or better on `bg` and `surface` in both themes).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-muted` (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse` and on photography under a navy overlay.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand colour for icons, chart strokes, large display text (24px and up) and rules. Not for small text on light: use `action`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Buttons, links, selected states and small green labels. 5.5:1 with `on-action` on light, 11.6:1 on dark.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an `action` fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips, selected rows and highlight bands. Text on it: `action` or `text`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, compliant, approved. Always paired with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Pill and banner fill behind `status-ok` text.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Needs review, pending approval. Always paired with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Pill and banner fill behind `status-warning` text.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Non-compliant, action required, destructive confirmation. Always paired with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: status-critical-bg
tokens.usage: Pill and banner fill behind `status-critical` text.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and secondary chart series. Always paired with the word or an icon.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Pill and banner fill behind `status-info` text.

tokens.name: deep-navy
tokens.usage: Brand core. The wordmark on light, the dark ground of the product and dark slides.

tokens.name: basera-green
tokens.usage: Brand core. The b in the logo and the single brand hue. Graphics, icons, large text; 4.3:1 on white, so not for small text. White text on it is 4.3:1: use `action` for buttons.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Brand core. End of the logo gradient, and the highlight and action colour on navy (11.6:1 on `deep-navy`). Never text on light grounds (1.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: aqua-200
tokens.usage: Hover for `action` on dark. Navy text on it: 13:1.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Brand core. Quiet surfaces and dividers on light.

tokens.name: green-50
tokens.usage: Lightest tint. Chip and highlight backgrounds.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Tint for selected states on light.

tokens.name: green-200
tokens.usage: Soft fills and illustration.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Chart fills and illustration. Not for text.

tokens.name: green-400
tokens.usage: Chart fills and illustration. Not for text.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Same value as `basera-green`.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: The action colour on light. White text on it: 5.5:1. Links and small green text on `bg`: 5.1:1.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `action` on light; `status-ok` on light (6.0:1 on `green-50`).

tokens.name: green-800
tokens.usage: Deep green for dark illustration and print.

tokens.name: green-900
tokens.usage: Deepest green. Shadow tones in illustration.

tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Deepest ground behind dark imagery and the nav rail of the product.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Same value as `deep-navy`.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Card surface on the dark ground.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered surface on the dark ground.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Dividers and strong outlines on navy.

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Muted text on light grounds (5.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on navy (8.3:1 on `deep-navy`).

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Disabled strokes and placeholder lines on light.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Colour: `text`, or `text-inverse` on `surface-inverse`.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: A unified home for IT and security operations.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Too many systems. Too little certainty.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Know what is changing, where and why.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Basera brings fragmented environments together in one trusted place.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Review firewall configuration and policy changes across every tenant.
styles.usage: Default body text, 65 characters per line at most.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section label above a heading. Set in capitals, colour `action` on light and `aqua` on dark.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Rule names, IDs and configuration snippets.

type.notes: Wordmark only: Michroma Custom Bold, outlined in the logo files. Do not set text in it. Text is Inter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls and block gaps on the cover.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between elements in a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile and slide margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero padding and page-level breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, table cell highlights, small inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, metric tiles, dashboard panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App icon corners and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards that need to lift off `bg`. Prefer a 1px `border`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and device mockups.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: The b in the logo and one hero accent per view, always left to right. Never on text, never behind data.
